notes.title: Update Notes (alpha-0.0.12)
notes.content:
[h3]Changed Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] In map, the marker's name will be displayed when pointer over the marker.

[*] Some frenzy state system has been changed. After escape points are activated and the zombie's count is low, the frenzy will be released and day will incoming.

notes.title: Update Note (alpha-0.0.11)
notes.content:
[h3]Changed Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] The higher difficulty features are integrated into the lower difficulty.
[*] Now the changed feature hint will appear when selecting difficulty.
[*] The daily strengthening of the zombie's health is increased in all difficulties
[*] In the forest environment, the collisions of small rocks and logs are removed in certain area.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Note (alpha-0.0.10)
notes.content:
[h3]Changed Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ammunition's acquisition amount and the drop rate are slightly increased. Also, it's maximum carry amount and storage are increased.
[*] The controls hint added above the shortcut. It can be disabled or enabled in game settings too.
[*] The collision of forest environment object is improved. The small rocks are no longer collided and some environment's collision is more sophisticated.
[/list]

The game settings was reset because of controls hint update. This is not about important data like a backpack, it's only for game settings.

The game balance still not completed, and I will try to improve it constantly. Please feedback through discord or forum.

notes.title: [Devlog] Field Item and Backpack
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=26qo1WXqpOE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Description[/h3]
Introduce about field items and backpack management system
Each item has its own weight, and can't acquire items if weight of backpack is not enough.
The weapons in loadout is not consume the weight.

[h3]Sort of Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Weapon - The weapon has its own grade, level and additional options. Let's find some good things.
[*] Consumable - You can use it after register to quick slot
[*] Ammunition - The guns need this for reload. ammo has 4 types.
[*] Barricade Ingredient - It need when set up the barricade.
[/list]

notes.title: [Devlog] Introduce developed zombies
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=L_bIEvPv5tM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Description[/h3]
First content that I introduce is type of zombies. The zombies are classified into normal and event.
Normal zombies are steadily spawned, and decreased walker count in harder difficulty.
Event zombies are randomly appeared when certain time over.

[h3]Normal Zombies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Walker - Most general type
[*] Runner - Always run for me
[*] Biter - Can't move while holding player
[/list]

[h3]Event Zombies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bomber - Explode when get closed or dead. It very hurts
[*] Runner - Suddenly appears from back, front, left, right
[*] Pack Leader - Make zombies to run and improve
[/list]
